title: A technician can hold multiple shifts on the same day from different work orders
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. Two different work orders have schedulable lines.
3. You are on the Schedule page.
custom_steps:
1. Schedule a shift from work order 1 onto a technician for a given day.
2. Schedule a shift from work order 2 onto the SAME technician for the SAME day at a non-overlapping time.
custom_expected:
1. Both shifts are created and shown on the same day for the same technician - multiple same-day shifts are allowed.
2. With non-overlapping times, no conflict is raised and both share one lane.
